# Third-party code used by the Chess section

| File | Project | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `chess.min.js` | chess.js (rules, move generation, PGN) | 1.4.0 | BSD-2-Clause (`CHESSJS-LICENSE.txt`) | https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js |
| `chessground.min.js`, `css/chessground.css` (pieces) | chessground, the Lichess board | 10.1.1 | GPL-3.0-or-later (`CHESSGROUND-LICENSE.txt`) | https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground |
| `stockfish/stockfish-17.1-lite-single-*.js/.wasm` | Stockfish.js 17.1 lite (single-threaded) | 17.1.0 | GPL-3.0 (`stockfish/COPYING.txt`) | https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js · https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish |

Piece images: "cburnett" set by Colin M.L. Burnett, CC BY-SA 3.0, as bundled with chessground.
Files are unmodified builds from npm (chess.js minified with esbuild).
